# Audit — teach
*Read-understand-gap @ ed37663 · 140 lines + 3 format refs (skimmed) · 2026-07-28*

**What:** User-invoked, STATEFUL teaching workspace in the current directory: MISSION.md (the why — grounds everything; populated first), RESOURCES.md (high-trust sources; "never trust your parametric knowledge"), lessons/*.html (one tightly-scoped, beautiful, quickly-completable lesson per session, ZPD-calibrated from learning-records/), reference/*.html (the durable compressed artifacts — lessons are rarely revisited, references are), assets/ (reusable components, shared stylesheet first), NOTES.md. Learning science encoded: fluency vs STORAGE strength; desirable difficulties (retrieval, spacing, interleaving) for skills; difficulty minimized for knowledge acquisition; wisdom delegated to real communities.
**Dependencies:** none (self-contained workspace). **Security:** clean.
**Territory vs study (the reason this audit matters):** teach = interactive ZPD lessons built in A WORKSPACE from web-researched resources; study = curriculum/librarian over MY canon (Drive summaries), retention layer, reading paths. Both manual; study's SKILL.md will name this boundary explicitly. study should STEAL: mission-first grounding, storage-vs-fluency framing, reference-docs-outlive-lessons.
**Audit outcome:** clean; primary design input for the study build (used below).
